en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large Gothic church complex viewed from a nearby street or terrace. The main building has a rose window over the entrance, ribbed apse with tall pointed windows, and tiled roofs. A bell tower stands to the left and a stone cross or monument rises in the square before the church, where several people are gathered. The scene looks slightly worn and aged, consistent with early 20th‑century postcards. Printed text along the bottom reads the place name and subject of the view.
